# LLM Integration Requirements Checklist: Candidate Route Baseline and Role Contracts

**Purpose**: Assess whether model-and-effort candidate, role-contract identity, route-state, and unsupported-claim requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and reviewable.
**Created**: 2026-07-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Candidate Eligibility and Evidence Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the required fields for every model-and-effort candidate complete enough to preserve identity, capabilities, rationale, incompatibilities, qualification needs, provenance, and invalidation triggers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010; Data Model §CandidateRoute]
- [x] CHK002 Is the requirement to include every evidence-supported eligible project candidate explicit, including the immutable production baseline? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011; Plan §Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK003 Are the only permitted candidate-exclusion grounds enumerated and tied to cited evidence plus the affected role-contract field? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012; Data Model §Incompatibility]
- [x] CHK004 Is local installation unavailability explicitly separated from project eligibility so it cannot silently exclude a candidate? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012–FR-013; Data Model §CandidateRoute]
- [x] CHK005 Are hard authorization, safety, grounding, mutation, tool, sandbox, and output-contract incompatibilities consistently defined as exclusion conditions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006 and §FR-012; Data Model §Incompatibility]

## Prompt, Contract, and Variant Identity

- [x] CHK006 Are canonicalization requirements complete for Unicode normalization, line endings, retained whitespace, UTF-8 encoding, and hash format? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications Session 2; Data Model §Canonical identity rules]
- [x] CHK007 Is the `instruction_hash` input boundary unambiguous about the decoded instruction body and the excluded frontmatter, route, and transport syntax? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications Session 2; Data Model §Canonical identity rules]
- [x] CHK008 Is the `contract_hash` payload defined as the agent name plus exactly the FR-006 semantic fields, with deterministic serialization and explicit exclusions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006 and §FR-008; Data Model §Canonical identity rules]
- [x] CHK009 Are readable contract and candidate ID formats, non-reuse rules, and rank-free identity semantics specified consistently across the requirements and manifest contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008 and §FR-010; Contract §Identity and hashing]
- [x] CHK010 Is every prompt or context variant required to cite evidence for a bounded-overhead hypothesis and retain an unchanged-treatment attribution control? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014; Plan §Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK011 Are variant treatment identity, exact model, exact effort, both hashes, and evidence-backed rationale kept distinct enough to prevent variant evidence from being attributed to the unchanged candidate? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications Session 2 and §FR-010; Data Model §CandidateRoute]

## Hypotheses, Executability, and Qualification Boundaries

- [x] CHK012 Is candidate eligibility explicitly framed as a project-level hypothesis rather than proof of installation availability, executability, or qualification? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011 and §FR-013; Data Model §Model boundaries]
- [x] CHK013 Are qualification states limited to `unqualified` and `not_applicable_excluded`, with capability checks, fixture evidence, artifacts, telemetry, and downstream ownership still required? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications Session 2; Data Model §QualificationRequirements]
- [x] CHK014 Do the requirements prohibit undocumented claims of executable availability, effective routing, qualification, preference, optimality, or fallback order? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, §FR-018, and §FR-027; Plan §PR Review Packet Source]
- [x] CHK015 Is lexical candidate ordering explicitly presentation-only so it cannot imply preference, optimality, or fallback rank? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications Session 2; Contract §Candidate and policy bounds]
- [x] CHK016 Are G56R-001 research conclusions separated from G56R-002 capability and installation-availability decisions and G56R-003 scoring, qualification, and route-ordering decisions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023 and §Dependencies; Plan §Design Decisions]

## Null, Unavailable, and Undocumented States

- [x] CHK017 Are present and absent production-route requirements complete, including the exact 10/2 split, permitted absent agents, null bindings, and cited absence reasons? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003 and §SC-002; Data Model §ProductionRoute]
- [x] CHK018 Is `installation_availability.status` required to remain `unresolved_g56r_002` for every candidate regardless of sanitized local observations? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications Session 2 and §FR-013; Contract §Agent record]
- [x] CHK019 Must every capability field contain either a concrete requirement or an explicit unresolved value with evidence and owner, instead of an undocumented implicit null? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010 and §FR-023; Data Model §CapabilityRequirements]
- [x] CHK020 Are official-source silence and explicit non-applicability distinguished as `undocumented` versus evidence-backed `not_applicable` for each independent Codex surface? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017 and §FR-020; Contract §Evidence and surfaces]
- [x] CHK021 Are empty arrays and permitted nulls treated as explicit values while missing candidate, incompatibility, route, or unknown fields remain errors? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications Session 2; Plan §Evidence and Validation Design]

## Evidence, Agreement, and Acceptance Quality

- [x] CHK022 Does every evidence-backed candidate rationale require a visible classification, non-ranking summary, and evidence IDs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010 and §FR-018; Data Model §Rationale]
- [x] CHK023 Are unsupported dominance or exclusion conclusions prevented by requiring applicable predeclared evidence rather than recency, local state, or unstated preference? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012 and §FR-019; Plan §Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK024 Are cross-artifact agreement requirements complete for candidate IDs, hashes, model-effort-treatment tuples, eligibility, installed availability, capabilities, rationale, incompatibilities, qualification, provenance, and invalidation triggers? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications Session 2 and §SC-008; Plan §Evidence and Validation Design]
- [x] CHK025 Can candidate completeness and policy-boundary requirements be objectively assessed through the exact-set, required-field, hash, control, exclusion, availability, and prohibited-claim criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003–SC-004 and §SC-008; Plan §Requirement and Acceptance Traceability]
- [x] CHK026 Are blocking evidence conflicts and unclassified capability unknowns tied to `no_go`, while properly owned G56R-002 unknowns may remain without becoming unsupported route conclusions? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §FR-019 and §FR-023–FR-025; Data Model §Unknowns and handoff]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`.
- Record requirement-quality findings inline and use the registered gap marker only when the cited artifacts do not define the required behavior.
- This checklist assesses requirements writing; it does not execute, score, qualify, or select candidate routes.
